d: Short strawberry blonde hair with a single long ahoge strand and a high ponytail held by a white fluffy band. Bright azure eyes with a stern, focused expression on a youthful, adolescent face. A slender build wearing a black and red striped dress with a white fur collar and a gold-trimmed dark brown pauldron adorned with a red rose emblem. Accessories include a large, dark grey metallic sword held behind the back.
